choices.label: We will read together at school tomorrow.
choices.feedback: Time and place usually establish the setting before manner and the action. Scope words apply to the phrase they frame; moving them can change who, where or what is included. The position of 只 changes its scope: before 在学校 it limits the place; immediately before 看书 it limits the activity at that place. The focus of 只 also depends on context: 只看书 may restrict the reading material rather than exclude every other activity.
